intro: Word to PDF converts DOC and DOCX documents to PDF while keeping their layout: fonts, tables, headers, images and page breaks. It is the safest way to send a CV, a letter or a report and be sure the recipient sees it exactly as you prepared it, whether or not they have a word processor installed.

The conversion runs on our server with LibreOffice, with no internet access during the process. You can choose a standard PDF, PDF/A for long-term archiving or PDF/UA with accessibility tags, limit the result to a page range and decide whether bookmarks and form fields are exported.

Under more options you can set the JPEG quality of images and their maximum resolution, useful when the document contains many photos and you want a lighter PDF. If the file is password protected, type the password: it is only used to open the document during the conversion and is not stored.
You can convert several documents at once; you get each PDF separately plus a ZIP with all of them. Files are deleted automatically after one hour if you do not have an account.

faq.a: The document's fonts are used when they are embedded or available on the server; otherwise they are replaced with metric-compatible ones so the text takes up the same space.
A PDF flavour designed to preserve documents for years, required by many public bodies for official submissions.

faq.q: Can I convert Excel and PowerPoint too?
faq.a: Yes, with Excel to PDF and PowerPoint to PDF, or with Convert to PDF, which accepts any Office format.
